notes: Yuri authorised the provider-neutral bounded agent-admission design on 2026-07-23.

The authority permits repository-local authored-synthetic design and deterministic validation only. It opens no model, provider, transport, prompt transmission, container, network, secret, product, mailbox or command runtime.

claim_scope: A non-executing admission envelope separates immutable instruction policy from minimal typed evidence and preserves draft-only deterministic proofreader egress.
Three future topology candidates are risk-catalogued but unselected; model-specific behaviour, token accounting and runtime isolation remain unproved.

decisions.summary: Design an unoccupied provider-neutral cognition adapter with minimal context, fixed model-independent limits, terminal cancellation and proofreader-only draft egress without selecting or invoking a model or transport.
Accept the structural policy/evidence separation, exact predecessor port inheritance, fifteen deterministic cases and six inert manifests without widening runtime authority.

title: Ariadne Bounded Agent-Admission Design
unresolved_gates: Any topology or model selection, token budget, weights/image use, provider/broker connection, prompt/context transmission or generated draft requires a fresh Yuri decision.

Product reads, databases, event feeds, live mailboxes, human-gate UI, PII, protected/historical evidence, Stage 3B, production, deployment, release, commands and autonomous action remain separately closed.
